scope: Analysis only of one already completed ordinary-default Chromium JMdict import. No product checkout, build, import, browser launch, timing acquisition, performance comparison, or candidate change.

analysisProtocol.primary: Exact leaf sample counts, grouped by role/source frame. Inclusive ancestors explicitly overlap.
analysisProtocol.identity: Exact original run/job/artifact IDs, complete success, artifact digest and byte count; exact trace/report/summary/control hashes; unchanged acquired tracked/runtime manifests and release package hash.
analysisProtocol.source: Use only source bytes read from the exact acquired release ZIP and checked against its runtime manifest. Parse actual WASM export section without compiling or guessing internal C symbols. Preserve unmapped indices and document dynamic ancestor inference. CallFrame source lines are labelled function-declaration locations, never sampled executed lines.
analysisProtocol.profile: Retain ProfileChunks in original trace-array order, with original event index/timestamp/emitter/data. Reconstruct each(pid,id) after stable chunk sorting by(event ts,original event index), preserving per-chunk sample and signed-delta order. Validate node identity, references, parents, cycles, sample/delta counts, and acquisition inventory. Persist chunkMergeOrder.
analysisProtocol.weighting: After chronological chunk reconstruction, cumulatively apply every signed delta from profile start; stable-sort(timestamp,reconstructionOrder) for adjacent weights. Assign only each sorted sample's gap to its successor. Do not assign prefix/tail or synthesize endTime. Preserve original chunks plus reconstructed and chronological views.
analysisProtocol.intervalInterpretation: Adjacent weights and observed non-idle sample ranges are wall attribution, not CPU time, utilization, continuous busy periods, additive critical-path costs, removable costs, or speedup bounds. No trace time enters promotion or any comparative cohort.
analysisProtocol.correctness: Bind the already completed acquisition canonical validation to exact coverage/report/summary bytes. Do not claim new decoding, fresh lookups, or an independent new import.
analysisProtocol.output: Full raw reconstructed profiles, stable chronological sample views, exact per-role leaf/inclusive/native owner tables, 50ms sample-count bins, source/module identities, original before/after/coverage receipts, analysis source/plan/workflow hashes, and compact readable job-log tables.
analysisProtocol.failure: No retry or replacement import. Preserve every analysis failure. A later analysis-source repair can read the same immutable artifact as a distinct analysis revision; it is not a new timing cohort.
analysisProtocol.window: Read exact frozen trace harness source by dcfc and verify its acquired SHA256. Record source-ordered trace-start/completion/awaited-stop/explicit-validation anchors, actual trace-stop log lines, complete raw report phases, compact phase/import timings, trace timestamp/user-timing events. No automatic shared-clock timed-import window mapping or crop is asserted. Tables describe all captured samples.

execution.runtime: Ubuntu runner's standard Python only. No third-party Python packages, Node setup, npm, compiler, browser, database, or importer. One checksum-bound frozen harness source file is read without credentials to preserve boundary evidence; it is never executed.
execution.controlBinding: Fetch analysis controls without credentials from raw.githubusercontent.com at the invoking GITHUB_SHA; workflow hard-codes their SHA256 checks. Download original artifact using actions:read; never forward GitHub Authorization to its signed-storage redirect.
execution.localStatus: Source authored in V8 while the executor is explicitly unavailable. Deterministic Python tests will execute before the hosted analysis. No local Python/YAML/actionlint execution is claimed.
